note: The Basics: short TOPIC episodes (ElevenLabs, one voice), suitable for newer players or younger players (owner, 20 October 2026; project/podcast_principles_series_plan.md). Unlike podcast.json and podcast-principles.json this is NOT per document: `planned` fixes the topics, in series order, each with a slug, a working title and the one to three corpus documents (`sources`) it draws on. `episodes` holds only the published ones and is written by scripts/build_podcast_audio.py --style basics --slug <slug>. Each episode carries an explicit guid learn-ice-hockey:core:<slug>, written when it is first published and never changed. Audio lives at /audio/principles/basics/<slug>-<sha8>.m4a. Each episode is listed on /the-basics/ and linked from its source pages as soon as it exists, but the season stays OUT of the podcast feed until every planned topic is published.
